prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before any platelet simulation was run. Not blinded: the PK engine had been run, so peak concentrations (135 ng/mL at injection, 82 ng/mL at 5 min) and therefore the times above the effect-term zero points were known. No platelet trajectory under any reading had been computed.
not_this: Not validation: Lonial 2005 is the dataset the model was fitted to.
Not a choice between the myelosuppression and platelet-budding variants; both are evaluated and both are kept.
Not a dosing or toxicity prediction for any patient.
question: Under which reading of the unstated details (units of C; whether the effect term is bounded at zero) does the Lignet 2022 model reproduce the observed fall in mean platelet count by cycle 1 day 11?

fixed_assumptions.initial_state: Prol = Trans1 = Trans2 = Trans3 = Circ = Circ0 of the variant (pre-treatment steady state)

effect_bound.unbounded_as_printed: (1 - slope*C) used as printed, including negative values

readings.grid: All 8 combinations (2 units x 2 bounds x 2 variants).

regimen: 1.3 mg/m2 IV bolus at days 1, 4, 8, 11 of a 21-day cycle (t = 0, 72, 168, 240 h); cycle 2 starts at t = 504 h; simulate to 504 h.

numerics.method: Fixed-step RK4 on the five platelet compartments, with the exact PK concentration evaluated at each stage.
numerics.steps: 0.002 h for the first 4 h after each dose, 0.05 h otherwise; steps split at dose times.
numerics.convergence_check: Repeat each reading with all steps halved; the endpoint values must agree within 1e-4 relative, otherwise the reading is reported as numerically unresolved.
numerics.invalid_state: If Circ, Prol or any transit compartment becomes zero or negative, the reading is reported as invalid_state (the feedback term (Circ0/Circ)^gamma is undefined) and is not consistent.

primary.name: cycle1_day11_ratio
primary.definition: Circ just before the day-11 dose (t = 240 h, pre-dose) divided by Circ0 of the variant
primary.interval_derivation: ratio +/- 1.96 x SE, with SE from the delta method using SD/sqrt(n) for both means and ignoring their positive correlation (conservative: the true interval is narrower).

descriptive.name: cycle2_day1_ratio
descriptive.definition: Circ at t = 504 h divided by Circ0
descriptive.observed: recovering to baseline during the rest periods (qualitative)

descriptive.name: nadir_ratio_and_time
descriptive.definition: minimum Circ/Circ0 over 0-504 h and its time

descriptive.name: time_effect_term_negative_h
descriptive.definition: total hours over 0-504 h with 1 - slope*C < 0 (unbounded readings)

classification_rule.consistent: Primary ratio inside the interval, numerically resolved and no invalid_state.

decision_rule.adopt_reading: A unit-and-bound reading is adopted as primary if it is consistent for BOTH variants. If several qualify, all are reported and the one with ng/mL units (matching the source PK figures) is preferred; if still more than one, the bounded reading is preferred because it matches the stated mechanism (inhibition, not destruction).
decision_rule.partial: If a reading is consistent for only one variant, it is reported as such and nothing is adopted for the other variant.
decision_rule.none: If no reading is consistent for a variant, no reading is adopted for it; the variant is shown only with all readings labelled unresolved.
decision_rule.never: No parameter is re-estimated or tuned to improve the match.

known_differences: Model outputs are typical values; the observed values are means across patients with dose holds and reductions.
Lignet fitted digitised Figure 2 means, which may differ slightly from the text values used here.
The PK model overstates first-dose exposure about 7-fold (single clearance); day 11 follows four doses, so the effect is reduced but not removed.
The variants have their own fitted Circ0 (171 and 135) against an observed baseline of 165; the ratio endpoint removes this difference.
